name: Battlestar Galactica: HUMAN vs CYLON
description: The most intense dueling roller coaster in Asia — Battlestar Galactica features two separate coasters racing side by side with near-miss interactions throughout. HUMAN is a sit-down coaster delivering 5 inversions while CYLON is a suspended inverted coaster with 3 inversions. Together they create one of the most spectacular and thrilling dueling coaster experiences in the world. Min 125cm.

name: Revenge of the Mummy
description: A legendary indoor psychological roller coaster that combines high-speed launches, complete darkness and elaborate Egyptian theming to create one of the most disorientating and thrilling indoor coaster experiences in Asia. A Universal Studios institution worldwide and one of the best themed indoor coasters ever built. Min 122cm.

name: Transformers The Ride: The Ultimate 3D Battle
description: A state-of-the-art motion simulator dark ride combining physical sets with high-definition 3D projection technology to put guests in the middle of an epic battle between Autobots and Decepticons. One of the most technologically impressive rides in Asia and universally praised as one of the finest simulator attractions ever built. Min 102cm.

name: Accelerator
description: A high-speed spinning flat ride in the Sci-Fi City zone that launches riders in a rapidly accelerating spinning disc delivering intense g-forces and disorienting rotational thrills — one of the most popular thrill rides at Universal Studios Singapore. Min 122cm.

name: Jurassic World Raptor Encounter
description: A thrilling close encounter with life-size animatronic velociraptors from the Jurassic World franchise — guests come face to face with Blue and her pack in a heart-pounding wildlife encounter that is one of the most photogenic and memorable experiences at Universal Studios Singapore. Suitable for all ages.

name: WaterWorld
description: The most spectacular live stunt show in Asia — WaterWorld is a breathtaking water stunt spectacular with professional stunt performers executing extraordinary sequences of jet ski stunts, explosions, fire effects and dramatic action sequences in a purpose-built 3000-seat arena. An unmissable experience at Universal Studios Singapore. Suitable for all ages.

name: Shrek 4-D Adventure
description: A hilarious 4D cinema experience that continues the story of Shrek and Princess Fiona with all-new animated adventures — featuring moving seats, water effects, air blasts and scent effects that bring the comedy and magic of Shrek to spectacular 4D life. Suitable for all ages.

name: Puss In Boots Giant Journey
description: A delightful family coaster themed to Puss In Boots from Shrek — guests ride oversized enchanted books through a fairytale kingdom of giant beanstalks and magical landscapes. One of the most charming and family-friendly coasters in the Far Far Away zone. Min 107cm.

name: Canopy Flyer
description: A suspended family coaster that swoops guests through the Lost World jungle canopy in hang-glider style vehicles — delivering beautiful views of the park and genuinely exciting swooping sensations. One of the most scenic and enjoyable family coasters at Universal Studios Singapore. Min 107cm.

name: Dino-Soarin
description: A gentle flying dinosaur ride for young visitors where pterodactyls carry guests through a prehistoric sky — one of the most beloved and adorable family attractions in the Lost World zone. Perfect for young children visiting Universal Studios Singapore. Min 92cm.

name: Sesame Street Spaghetti Space Chase
description: A fun interactive dark ride where guests join Elmo, Cookie Monster and the Sesame Street gang on a space adventure to retrieve stolen spaghetti — collecting points by blasting targets along the way. One of the most popular family dark rides at Universal Studios Singapore. Suitable for all ages.

name: Magic Potion Spin
description: A classic spinning teacup ride in the Far Far Away zone themed to the magic potions of Shrek — guests spin in giant potion bottles in a fun and accessible family experience beloved by young children. Suitable for all ages.

name: Ancient Egypt Zone
description: The most elaborately themed zone at Universal Studios Singapore — Ancient Egypt recreates the atmosphere of a 1930s Hollywood Egyptian adventure with magnificent temple facades, hieroglyphic corridors and the iconic Revenge of the Mummy indoor coaster. One of the finest themed environments in Asia. Suitable for all ages.
